facts.fact: Tidiani Togola (Tuwindi founder) says Mali's 2019 cybercrime text does not specifically cover deepfakes and that Mali has no rules adapted to AI.

MLI.note: No government body is said to use or test an AI system; only a digital week on e-government and AI and a planned annual forum.
Radiologists beginning to use AI tools is not tied to a public system; farm advice by SMS is not said to use AI.

facts.fact: Tidiani Togola says that to his knowledge Mali has no published national AI strategy, unlike about fifteen African countries, and that one should be drawn up.

facts.fact: Tidiani Togola says RobotsMali and the MALIBA-AI community have assembled hundreds of hours of Bambara recordings and built speech-recognition tools in Bambara, Bomu, Dogon and Songhai.
